note: The hours of a filing office whose clerk has no work record to read (a state's election office, a finance officer who is not one of the town's full people). Read only where the clerk's own work spans (`workSpansOf`) hold nothing; stopgap SG-PLAY-office-hours-assumed.

estimated.source: Government offices that take filings keep weekday business hours, about 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (county and municipal clerks' published counter hours; a game assumption, the same kind the work schedules use for hours with no record). Holidays are not skipped here.
estimated.spread: opening 7:30 to 9:00 AM, closing 4:30 to 5:30 PM
